title: Slice 1 stack: React + TypeScript + mock data; no backend, Java, Docker, Postgres or brokerage connection
context: First slice narrowed to an options-chain module; avoid infrastructure complexity.
rationale: This was intentional. The first slice should produce working observable software, not infrastructure complexity.
subsequent: Browser-only evidence acquisition hit its limits; backend evidence service accepted 2026-07-15 and Java/Spring Boot preferred the same day.
notes: Recorded as 'We chose'; speaker not identified.

title: Constrain Kiro during implementation; allow bounded design-review checkpoints; Kiro must not silently change domain, architecture or design
context: Kiro used inside a larger methodology that starts before requirements→design→tasks.
rationale: Kiro is not the whole methodology. Kiro is one component inside a larger learning loop.
expected_consequences: Implementation stays within spec; design changes surface explicitly.
subsequent: Echoed in steering 'Implementation Engineer' rules (do not redesign architecture during implementation; do not silently deviate).
notes: Earliest form of actor-role constraint; predates Principal/Architect/IE vocabulary.

title: Stop Massive integration until paid plan; preserve spike code; mock provider stays primary
context: Massive options snapshot returned HTTP 403 on free tier.
evidence_at_time: CORS, auth and mapping validated; data entitlement blocked.
rationale: Spike code is architecturally correct and will work when entitlements are available.
subsequent: Tradier became the provider (Opportunity Lab uses TradierProvider by L631).

title: Exclude all-zero bid/ask, zero-liquidity rows from the XLE reference fixture as provider-boundary normalization
context: Four Jul 24 rows had zero bid/ask and liquidity.
evidence_at_time: Rows violate bid<ask invariant and produce meaningless yield.
rationale: This is a provider-boundary normalization decision, not a domain limitation.
notes: Header date 2025-07-05 (typo). Tension with 'reference fixtures should not be modified' (L470) is resolved by framing exclusion as normalization.

title: No composite 'deployment efficiency' metric; preserve operational-fit axis as open question
context: Explanation panel revealed Mechanics vs Participation axes and an unnamed third axis.
alternatives: Deployment Efficiency = yield normalized by capital
rationale: The question is not a ratio. It appears to be an operational fit assessment

title: Computability gate ('Three Kinds of Knowledge') adopted as standing methodology rule
context: Attempt to add an 'Objectives' layer above Operating Model failed the derivation test.
evidence_at_time: Objectives such as smooth income do not enable deterministic computation.
rationale: Prematurely formalizing philosophical concepts creates types that can't justify their fields
expected_consequences: Gate applied before introducing new abstractions.
subsequent: Not found in principles.md or foundations (grep 'elevate rationale' = 0 hits).
notes: Self-described 'standing methodology rule' with no recorded ratifier.

title: History/ML guardrail: history refines operation, not prophecy — standing scope boundary
context: Discussion moving toward historical evidence and machine-assisted learning.
evidence_at_time: Charter 'Policy over prediction' judged insufficiently nuanced.
rationale: The project never set out to build a better predictor of future market prices. It set out to build a better options overlay.
expected_consequences: Future history/pattern/learning capabilities must demonstrate alignment with overlay operation before implementation.

title: Velvet Rope first slice: observational, parallel to legacy curated universe; shared findClosestToDelta; broader delta range 0.15-0.50; localStorage transitional; append-only uncapped audit
context: Universe Management identified as a bounded context (Discovery/Admission/Registry).
evidence_at_time: Curated 15-ETF list indefensible (XLU, SPY capital quantum).
rationale: Velvet Rope asks "is this market viable?" not "which exact contract should I trade?" (delta range).
expected_consequences: Does not yet govern Opportunity Lab.
subsequent: Multi-expiration redesign (L3332); current steering calls Velvet Rope 'designed, not live'.

title: Defer API Ninjas subscription; Tradier sole data source for Velvet Rope
context: Free tier lacks enumeration and key fields.
rationale: The spike has quantified the cost, capability, and limitations — no remaining unknowns.
subsequent: FMP spike judged viable (L2618+); later universe from Yahoo seed.

title: Do not change Velvet Rope measurement or thresholds until patterns emerge; prioritize diagnostic narrative (VR-22) over measurement refinement
context: XLK, then XLE/SCHD rejections on single-contract OI/spread.
rationale: Thresholds are parameters. Measurement methodology is architecture.
expected_consequences: Audit trail becomes experimental evidence across policy versions.
subsequent: Multi-expiration evaluation later implemented (L3332); neighborhood question not closed in span.

title: ProductStructure as factual enrichment; structural caution → manual_review not reject; Strategy Authorization parked with explicit revisit trigger
context: SOXS passed market quality but is unsuitable for passive assignment.
alternatives: Hard exclusion rules such as excludeLeveraged: true
rationale: Only one counterexample (SOXS) has emerged ... The project methodology requires multiple data points before formalizing new architecture
expected_consequences: Velvet Rope explains structural facts conservatively.
subsequent: Strategy expansion governance documents exist later (docs/foundations/strategy-expansion-governance.md) — relationship not traced.
notes: Revisit trigger: 3+ instruments where ProductStructure + manual_review is insufficient (L2882).

title: Prior audit context first (informational, non-filtering, exact-match vs different-contract labels); same-contract policy lens deferred
context: XLK appeared contradictory across Opportunity Lab and Velvet Rope because different contracts were evaluated.
alternatives: Naive symbol-level admission badges (rejected as misleading)
rationale: Today's debugging proved that contract identity matters.

title: Evidence Context (session) parked with no code changes; observational annotation suggested as first slice
context: XLE flipped ADMIT→REJECT after close.
implementation: none at decision; 6-state MarketSessionPolicy + TradingCalendar complete by 2026-07-14 (L3557).
subsequent: ADR-007 Session-Aware Evidence Governance; session gate became a correctness invariant.

title: Foundations family: create three-actor-model, secondary-observation, policy-over-prediction; withhold further foundation docs until external-credibility criteria are met
context: Cross-domain pattern recognition (GIA reference diamonds).
rationale: If a principle survives the removal of all domain nouns (options, diamonds, ETFs, AI), it's foundational.
expected_consequences: Documents created when principles are ready for an external audience.
subsequent: Retire Uncertainty, Reality Arbitrates, Capabilities Over Containers 'promoted' but never documented (0 hits). Three-actor-model.md meaning changed in Aug 2026.
current_applicability: scoped:three docs current; promoted-but-undocumented set unknown
notes: Promotions here predate principles-governance-model.md; they are not Principal ratifications on the record.

title: /app/write: portfolio snapshot is an authoritative input contract; Fidelity is one source behind PortfolioSnapshotSource; Demo Mode first-class with no if(demo) branches
context: Transition from labs to first Operator surface.
expected_consequences: Same pipeline for demo and real portfolio.
subsequent: Option Summary as inventory authority later reversed by ADR-020 (Positions); portfolio ingestion became application-scoped (ADR-011).
current_applicability: scoped:source abstraction current; Option Summary inventory authority superseded
notes: Not among ADR-001..010 titles despite being a key decision.

title: Cash authority is a direct assignment: deployableCash = availableToTradeAllSettled from Fidelity Balances; no reconstruction
context: Brokerage-mediated capability (2026-07-10 rejection).
rationale: Fidelity already did the math.
subsequent: Later zero-cash outage / known $0 vs null (project-journal-5.md:9-36) concerns cash authority semantics — linkage not traced here.

title: Exact contracts are the operational unit; execution risk graded not binary; 15% spread becomes a preferred-quality reference rather than a gate
context: Velvet Rope single-symbol governance vs same-day operation.
rationale: Only true hard-no conditions ... remove a candidate from the primary list.
expected_consequences: Get close to the go/no-go edge so controlled real trades can begin.
implementation: Recommendation Board / Posture (ACTIONABLE/EDGE/WAIT presumed later expression — not verified).

title: Accept sessionClosed boolean shortcut as known technical debt with explicit replacement criteria
context: Session-gating corrective slice.
evidence_at_time: Provenance infrastructure defined but not integrated.
rationale: operationally acceptable for the current prototype because the only provider is Tradier sandbox ... The operator can reason about what's cached
expected_consequences: Replacement when write path carries EvidenceProvenance.
subsequent: Backend extraction (2026-07-15); ADR-015 Evidence Provenance Authority.

title: Move evidence acquisition from browser-owned crawl to a backend evidence service; Wheelwright stays client-side
context: Five crawl defects showed browser lifecycle incompatible with long-lived jobs.
evidence_at_time: Cursor at universe end with 363 symbols lacking chains; 12-click Rescan; stall misdetection.
rationale: a browser tab is fundamentally the wrong execution model for them
expected_consequences: Phased migration 0-5; frontend consumes conditional snapshots.
subsequent: Phase 2 'TypeScript' superseded same day by Java preference; 'Wheelwright stays client-side' later labeled transitional (PL-ARCH-06).
notes: 'Accept ADR' — acceptor not recorded. This ADR lives in docs/08-adr-backend-evidence-service.md, outside the ADR-001..023 register numbering.

title: Backend implementation preferences: Java/Spring Boot, SQLite or H2, AWS, security from day one
context: Earlier design proposed TypeScript/Node/SQLite.
rationale: based on operator familiarity and long-term maintainability
expected_consequences: JSON snapshot schema is the shared Java/TS contract.
subsequent: No Spring Security dependency observed in build.gradle.kts at bef03dd (grep only).
notes: Authority class inferred: preferences of the operator (Principal) recorded as 'working assumptions ... Open to revision'.

title: Single-click full acquisition loop as bridge to backend
context: Operator had to click Rescan 12 times.
rationale: This solves the symptom (12 clicks → 1 click) but not the cause
implementation: handleScan loops up to 20 passes with stopping conditions.

title: Conditioned Operating Opportunity evaluated first as explanatory evidence in the Brief before ranking integration
context: Design discussion on evaluating the Wheel's egress side.
rationale: Requires no new acquisition.

title: Recommendation engine always produces top-20 regardless of affordability; unaffordable rows flagged, Affordable-only toggle
context: After-hours zero-recommendation experience with low deployable cash.
expected_consequences: Operator sees candidates and why they are unaffordable.
implementation: Red $ indicator, red negative Remaining, toggle.
subsequent: Restated later as 'Affordability is a candidate property, not a Deployment/Explorer evaluation gate' (docs/journal/project-journal-5.md:33).
